text:
Anna P.: Quick sync — Datadog + NVIDIA + Kyndryl pipeline for the observability joint announcement. Need checklist and dates.
Rahul S.: +1. We should lock the marketplace listing + OTEL integration PR this week.
Tay L.: Are we targeting a coordinated marketplace listing (Datadog tile + NVIDIA validated) or separate announcements?
Samir (Datadog): Our preference is a coordinated launch week — one customer story, joint blog, and synced marketplace entries. Datadog can co-promote.
Jin (NVIDIA): NVIDIA engineering can share a validated perf note for GPU telemetry and a short benchmark we can attach to the listing.
Olivia G.: I'll own the actual marketplace copy and the screenshot assets. Need final dashboard images and a short 2-line lead paragraph from product.
Rahul S.: Action items from infra/eng: 1) OTLP exporter config + sample, 2) dashboard JSON for Datadog, 3) validated perf snippet from NVIDIA, 4) SI enablement doc for Kyndryl.
Nora (Kyndryl): We'll prepare an internal enablement deck and a runbook for customer installs. Need an integration test case and a short tech note we can include in our services catalog.
Anna P.: Proposed timeline: this week (dev) -> next Tue (internal review) -> next Thu (partner approvals) -> following Mon (soft launch to partners) -> following Fri (public announcement). Thoughts?
Tay L.: timeline seems tight but doable if engineering signs off by EOD Fri. We should put a hard freeze on marketplace copy 48h before partner approvals.
Samir (Datadog): Datadog legal needs 3 business days for co-marketing signoff. Add that into the calendar.
Olivia G.: Noted. I'll schedule a content sync and add a 3-day legal buffer.
Rahul S.: Here's the OTLP snippet I'm proposing for docs (simple ingest example):
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/https:
    endpoint: "https://ingest.redwood.ai:4318"
    headers: { "x-api-key": "<REDACTED>" }
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/https]
```
Olivia G.: That looks good. Can we also include a pre-built Datadog dashboard JSON? I'll need a 1200x800 PNG render for the marketplace tile.
Rahul S.: Attaching a minimal dashboard query (mock): `avg(redwood.request.latency{env:prod}) by {model}` — we can snapshot top 3 charts: latency p50/p95/error-rate.
Jin (NVIDIA): We'll provide a short perf blurb: "NVIDIA A10 + Redwood runtime reduces p95 by 30% vs CPU baseline" — we'll send validation data.
Anna P.: Great. Oliva/Tay — please coordinate PRs for marketplace and blog draft. Rahul/Jin — finish artifacts (OTEL, dashboard JSON, perf CSV). Nora — enablement deck draft.
announce-bot: Reminder: Partner co-announcement planning meeting scheduled for 2025-10-15 16:00 UTC (invite sent).
Tay L.: Can we lock a customer quote? Samir — any customers you can route for a short blurb?
Samir (Datadog): I can ask 2 customers; one likely to allow a short quote. Will update by Tue.
Olivia G.: I'll prepare the blog outline and ask for quotes in the doc.
Rahul S.: One technical note — ensure the KV-cache stats are exported to Datadog as gauge: `redwood.kv_cache.hits`/`misses` so SI teams can validate cost savings.
Nora (Kyndryl): We'll add an install checklist that validates OTEL ingestion, dashboard rendering, and KV metrics.
Anna P.: Perfect. Last call: any blockers?
Rahul S.: Dependency: eng-runtime needs a small endpoint tweak to accept Datadog ingestion headers. I'll open a PR today.
Tay L.: Marketing ask: embargo window? Prefer 48h embargo for press reachouts.
Samir (Datadog): Datadog can coordinate press; 48h embargo is fine.
Olivia G.: I'll draft the joint pitch and tag PR contacts.
Anna P.: Thanks — I'll consolidate this thread into the partner checklist doc and assign owners. Please update the doc by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
